content.text:
Yes—document panic as an all-notes/all-channels sweep that preserves transport and scheduled voices. I found no contradictory intent, but two oracle gaps warrant small fixes.

[README.md:310](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/README.md:310) promises clearing MIDI-on events; transport has a separate control at [README.md:224](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/README.md:224). [m_clock.lua:826](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/lib/clock/m_clock.lua:826) only calls `m_midi.panic()`—unchanged since commit `3b9ff54f` (2024). The sweep sends `note_off(note, 0, channel)` at [m_midi.lua:417](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/lib/m_midi.lua:417); transport Stop separately stops the lattice and resets scheduling. Clarify the manual’s ambiguous “stop signal” as “Note Off messages.”

- **Stop-drain false green:** [note_schedule.py:26](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/tests/behaviour/note_schedule.py:26) accepts `regular or truncated`, allowing a normal release deadline after Stop. Using actual M-PANIC-009/010 real-time traces, I moved the final release to its original deadline and restored its onset velocity: both passed, **375/353 ms after Stop’s upper bound**. Minimal fix: require every musical release no later than `stop_upper + tolerance`, retaining the existing deadline checks. Add this mutation as a regression test.

- **Unexpected transport messages escape accounting:** [cases.py:2733](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/tests/behaviour/cases.py:2733) passes all remaining MIDI to `assert_schedule`, but [note_schedule.py:11](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/tests/behaviour/note_schedule.py:11) ignores every non-note message. An erroneous MIDI Stop (`0xFC`) during panic therefore escapes these assertions even while the five musical onsets remain correct. Minimal fix: explicitly validate transport messages against identified Play/Stop boundaries and reject an injected Stop during panic.

The overlapping-sweep oracle correctly enforces independent ordered prefixes, incomplete earlier sweeps, complete final sweeps, and matching restart positions. All four mutation-test groups passed. I independently verified **12 manifest hashes and 180 artifact hashes**. The input-origin join uses action/session/native-sequence evidence; I found no output-fitted origin.

The [hotplug plan](/mnt/c/Users/andy/Documents/ChatGPT/monome-emulator/docs/architecture/midi-hotplug.md:10) covers the necessary lifecycle pitfalls: native removal/addition, retained handles, ownership, queued-input delivery rules, stable slots, and capability rejection. No additional design blocker found; R18 remains open pending implementation and native acceptance.

**CONFIDENCE: High.** Native runs and the prior 482-test suite were not rerun; this does not certify full panic/manual coverage or release readiness.
